description: Generate valid Review JSON-LD schema from your review details.

faqs.a: Fill in the item reviewed, your rating, and the review text, then click Generate.
faqs.q: How do I generate review schema?

faqs.a: Products, local businesses, movies, books and more — pick the type that fits.
Google requires the review to be visible on the page for review rich results.
faqs.q: Must the review appear on the page?

faqs.a: Copy the JSON-LD into your page and validate it with Google's Rich Results Test.
faqs.q: How do I use the output?

howto: Pick the type of item reviewed.
Enter the item name, your rating and the review.
Add author and date (optional but recommended).
Generate, copy and paste the JSON-LD into your page.
title: Review Schema Generator
